An '''individual''' served as [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] and Head of the [[House Nalju/Legends|House Nalju]], one of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FH" />

{{RPGseed}}
After [[Noble Guard|House Demici Noble Guardsmen]] [[Raid on a House Nalju encampment|attacked]] a [[Unidentified House Nalju encampment|House Nalju encampment]] and kidnapped an [[Unidentified House Nalju heir|heir]] of [[Count/Legends|Count]] Nalju, a group of [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] hired to locate a missing [[Unidentified House Demici heir|heir]] to [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Unidentified House Demici count|Demici]] followed the kidnappers to a canyon. Once inside, they discovered the two heirs have allied to drive their houses to war. They had planned to kill their fathers during the confusion and take over their respective houses, and after a brief arms race, unite House Demici and House Nalju and dominate Serenno.<ref name="FH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
A House Nalju count was first mentioned in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH" />
